concept.title: Enabling the Auto Insert Header Footer Data Option

conbody.p: When the Auto Insert Header Footer Data option is enabled/checked as true, the headers in your agreement documents will display the agreement number, and the footers will display the date (or last modified date) timestamp. The automatic header and footer will insert into your document during the following actions once enabled:

ul.li: When you create an offline agreement
When you import an offline agreement
When you regenerate an offline agreement

conbody.p: If this option is disabled/checked as false, then no automatic header or footer information will insert into your document during any of the above actions.
